text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for tenant=Valora (reserved-pool: valora-prod-pool) — high latency / queue saturation. Pager: https://pagerduty.example/PD-8921

pd-bot: Alert details: PD-8921, trigger=reserved_pool_qdepth, metric=p99_latency, current=1.24s (threshold=0.6s), queue_depth=312, pool_util=98%

maria_ong: Ack'd. I'm taking this. pulling dashboards now.

alex_cho: Standby — I'm secondary oncall. Any obvious customer-visible errors yet?

maria_ong: Seeing 502/504 spikes from the Valora tenant; their critical API is hitting timeouts. Dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/valora/tenant-health (p95/p99 shot up). Queue depth correlated with model-server restarts.

samir: @tara_ops can we allow pool to scale? autoscale locked to reserve policy during business hours.

tara_ops: Investigating. I see an autoscale safety flag set by a previous change. Checking why it's preventing scale.

jin_lee: Logs show repeated OOMs from model-worker-3 in valora-pool: 
```
E 2026-03-14T12:02:33Z model-worker-3: oom when allocating KV cache shard, malloc failed
E 2026-03-14T12:02:34Z model-worker-3: worker respawn
```

maria_ong: quick prometheus query: 
```
sum(rate(inference_requests_total{tenant="valora"}[1m])) by (route)
```
returns a bursty spike ~450rps mostly on `/v1/generate/long` route.

alex_cho: Suggest immediate mitigation: route heavy long requests to the smaller quantized variant and/or enable burst-capacity for Valora for 10m. That should reduce memory pressure.

samir: Noted. Customer impact: Valora support reports timeouts on their payment flow — high priority for them. I've pinged AMs.

tara_ops: I removed the autoscale safety flag: `infractl flags unset autoscale-lock valora-prod` and issued a scale request: `infractl scale reserved valora-prod-pool +2 --reason "PD-8921"` — job accepted. ETA for new workers ~90s.

incident-bot: Scale job queued (job id=scale-7743). Workers expected healthy in ~1.5m.

maria_ong: While nodes warm, I'm flipping a routing override for critical endpoints to the quantized fallback: 
```
routing override set tenant=valora route=/v1/generate/long target=model:valora-v1-quant ttl=600
```

jin_lee: Also bumping KV cache allocation on existing workers to reduce thrash: `configctl set valora.kv_cache_mb 512` — applying now.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Alert acknowledged by maria_ong, status=Acknowledged, assignee=maria_ong.

alex_cho: Metrics update: p95 down from 1.2s -> 0.38s within 3m of routing override. Queue depth down to ~40. Good signal.

samir: Classifying impact: Sev-2 (partial degradation, major API routes affected intermittently). Notifying account team (@acct-valora).

tara_ops: New nodes are up and joined the pool. GPU utilization now ~74%, previously 98%. queue depth continuing to fall.

maria_ong: Observed root cause candidate: sudden spike of long-context requests combined with model memory fragmentation leading to worker OOMs. Short-term mitigations applied: scaling, routing fallback, KV cache bump.

jin_lee: Follow-up actions I'm owning: open a ticket with model team to investigate memory fragmentation and worker restart pattern; add a mem-leak/regression test.

alex_cho: I'll create the incident follow-up ticket and capture timeline. INC-2026-173951 created and assigned to infra+model.

maria_ong: Handing off monitoring to next oncall in 2h — leaving notes in INC-2026-173951. If we see repeat alerts, escalate to eng-platform pager.

tara_ops: Will add a short-term autoscale exemption for Valora during known bursts and add a policy alert if safety-flag blocks scale in future.

maria_ong: Thanks team. Marking thread for postmortem and tagging remediation owners. :white_check_mark:

pd-bot: PagerDuty: All alerts for PD-8921 have been resolved/closed (no active alerts for 10m).
